review_candidates.title: Pre-Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: SOVOS Pre-Sales Engineer Sales Engineering·Full-Time·United Kingdom Build Your Future With Us The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to manage increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive. AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. The Role At Sovos, we're transforming how businesses manage complex global compliance. This Pre-Sales Engineer role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical advisory, supporting multi-country sales engagements across our tax and compliance technology portfolio. You'll act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, leading discovery, designing scalable solutions, and positioning the business value of our platform. More Specifically, You Will Lead complex, multi-entity discovery sessions across global customer organisations, mapping transaction flows, ERP landscapes, and regulatory exposure. Design scalable, cross-border solution architectures aligned to business and compliance needs, positioning commercial value alongside technical functionality. Influence technical and business stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, and partner with Sales to shape account strategy and advance deals through structured qualification. Own technical responses for enterprise RFPs, RFIs and global tenders, and deliver tailored demonstrations reflecting global regulatory and ERP scenarios. Operate as a trusted advisor in partner-led and embedded solution models, collaborating cross-functionally to ensure seamless transition from pre-sales to implementation. Contribute to global pre-sales best practices, messaging, and competitive positioning, and maintain high-quality demo environments aligned with market requirements. Leverage AI tools to improve discovery workflows, automate response generation, and enhance demonstration personalisation. What You Bring to Sovos You can lead structured discovery sessions, design scalable solutions, and confidently influence enterprise buying decisions You're skilled at leading structured discovery and solution mapping conversations, with a commercial mindset and the ability to influence customer buying decisions. Experience navigating ERP ecosystems is highly desirable; exposure to tax, compliance, regulatory, finance or adjacent domains is advantageous. You're comfortable operating autonomously with appropriate support with limited regional infrastructure, working effectively across time zones and global teams. You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English and you're willing to travel occasionally. Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and tools that enhance pre-sales efficiency and personalisation is a plus. Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. The Process We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect: 1 Pre-Employment Assessment Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot. 2 Video Interview A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume. 3 Meeting with a Recruiter A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals. 4 Live Interviews with the Hiring Team Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role. Life at Sovos The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside! Global Mentoring Programs AI Tools and Technology from Day 1 Continuous Learning and Development Language Learning Support Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs Global Parental Leave Policy Equal Opportunity Employer Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to contribute authentically and be valued for their unique perspectives and backgrounds. Company Background Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com. Ready to make your move? We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application SOVOS © Sovos 2026. All rights reserved.

review_candidates.description: We are Automotive Business Scientists. We empower our clients to turn overwhelming industry data into discovery, action, and measured success. We are unique market leaders because we find and examine possibilities through the clarity of a scientific lens. To solve the toughest client challenges, we need curious, creative, and dedicated people to join our team. We search out individuals who align with our core values and who adhere to the highest standards of integrity and ethics in everything they do. Our company is filled with the brightest minds and the biggest hearts at every level. We recognize that personal success takes on many different forms of the course of our lives - both professional and personally - so we provide a myriad of benefits and programs focused on Wellbeing, Growth, Community and Recognition. One size does not fit all, so we encourage every Urban Scientist to discover their own formula for success including hybrid and remote work options. If this sounds like the kind of company you would like to work with, Apply Now! Position Overview The Data Engineer position focuses on the curation of data so that it is useful for business functions and further analysis. There is a broad spectrum of skills and responsibilities the support this function. A Data Engineer operates within a larger Data Management function to provide technical support relevant to data to address the business needs of the organization. Within Urban Science, a Data Engineer generally deals with data that is used in products and services that Urban Science sells to its customers. That data comes from diverse sources, clients, venders and technologies, and requires considerable processing and integration to deliver the insights that are beneficial to our customers. The Data Engineer has a high level of responsibility within this data integration and processing function. In addition to knowledge of data storage tools, software development is required to create the efficient, repeatable processes for preparing and moving the data through the systems. Various technologies and commercial tooling are needed, and Data Engineers will identify opportunities, select tools and configure and/or build and deploy those tools and technologies. When appropriate, training and communications will be necessary to enable broad usage of data tooling and the data itself. Data Engineers partner with product development teams and advanced analytics functions. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Design and Implement Develop, implement and maintain data pipelines, including the tooling, technologies and architecture required Interface with other technology teams both within and outside of Urban Science to integrate data from a variety of sources. This includes client data source teams, DBAs, consuming application teams and the analytics department Create data sets in support of data modeling, mining and production software applications Ensure database architectures will support the functional and non-functional requirements of Urban Science products, analytics and ad hoc investigations Employ a variety of languages and tools (e.g. scripting or compiled languages) to marry systems and sources together Apply software engineering best practices, data management fundamentals, data storage principles, recent advances in distributed systems, and operational excellence best practices Innovation Automate and create efficiencies in data processing pipelines Identify and recommend ways to improve data reliability, efficiency and quality Perform research and acquire new knowledge and skills on new technologies, processes, and tools for use in data management Processing Execute ongoing and ad hoc processing of data Apply data analysis methods and tools to enhance data cleansing and readiness for use Perform data profiling and anomaly detection Managing data migrations/conversions and troubleshoot data processing issues Support Perform Tier 2 and general system support functions for data pipelines and systems Manage access control into data processing systems Standards Ensure data confidentiality and regulatory compliance Support and implement all security, regulatory and internal standards and policies in all data processes and tools Knowledge Sharing Document system architectures, design, business rules, configuration management specifics and system support approaches employed in data tooling and processes Actively support and participate in required Urban Science training programs to achieve targeted development objectives Overall Proactively communicates with upper management to provide updates and report issues in a timely manner Works with manager to complete annual goal setting and performance reviews in a timely manner Works with manager to prioritize all duties as assigned Qualifications To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Experience with SQL storage technologies, with a focus on Microsoft SQL server and related platform technologies. Demonstrated basic data modeling experience and knowledge of relational database modeling patterns Data integration and ETL/ELT patterns Software Engineering practices and processes Configuration management & deployment Education And/Or Experience Minimum Baccalaureate degree in Computer Science or related field from an accredited U.S. college or university, equivalent foreign institution, or equivalent experience. Non-technical degrees will be considered if candidate possesses appropriate level of analytical and technical knowledge required for the role 3+ years related work experience required 2+ years of hands-on experience in writing complex, highly-optimized SQL queries across large data sets 2+ years with scripting and/or compiled languages (e.g. Python, C#, etc.) WORK ENVIRONMENT The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. DISCLAIMER This description is intended to describe the type and level of work being performed by a person assigned to this position. It is NOT an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities required by a person so classified. The job may require additional hours beyond the normal 40-hour workweek.

review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Software Engineer based in United Kingdom. Join a fully remote engineering organization where your influence extends across teams, systems, and engineering practices. As a Staff Engineer, you will remain hands-on while leading major architectural initiatives and helping engineers make better technical decisions. You will shape the evolution of a distributed rendering platform, with a strong focus on simplicity, scalability, reliability, and testability. Your expertise will help teams move faster and more safely by removing systemic bottlenecks and establishing effective technical patterns and practices. You will work closely with engineering, product, and leadership teams to connect technical investments with broader business goals. Beyond writing code, you will coach engineers, build shared context, and raise the standard of engineering excellence across the organization. This role is ideal for a technically strong, systems-oriented leader who enjoys solving complex problems while empowering others to succeed. Accountabilities Contribute directly to core systems while setting high standards for code quality, testing, architecture, and software design. Lead cross-team architectural initiatives that simplify systems and improve scalability, reliability, performance, and testability. Design elegant solutions to complex technical challenges involving distributed systems and large-scale web rendering. Identify technical risks, systemic bottlenecks, and recurring challenges, then establish effective solutions and engineering defaults that enable teams to work efficiently. Coach and mentor engineers at different levels through pairing, design reviews, technical guidance, and hands-on support in engineering practices. Promote sustainable engineering practices such as test-driven development, pair programming, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. Partner with product and leadership teams to balance immediate delivery needs with long-term technical health and maintainability. Improve engineering tooling, automation, workflows, and shared practices to increase effectiveness across teams. Facilitate technical discussions and create shared context around architectural decisions, trade-offs, and strategic priorities. Review code and provide thoughtful, actionable feedback that helps engineers continuously improve. Establish patterns, guardrails, and good technical defaults that increase consistency and enable teams to move with confidence. Lead by example through ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and a continuous drive to improve systems and ways of working. Requirements 10+ years of professional experience designing and delivering complex software and distributed systems. Proven track record of leading large-scale technical or architectural initiatives that have simplified, strengthened, or significantly improved core systems. Deep expertise in modern backend development, ideally with TypeScript/Node.js or Golang. Strong familiarity with AWS and cloud-native infrastructure. Excellent understanding of system design, distributed architectures, performance, reliability, scalability, and software quality. Strong systems-thinking ability, with the capacity to connect product objectives, technical architecture, engineering practices, and organizational needs. Demonstrated ability to balance short-term delivery priorities with long-term maintainability and technical sustainability. Experience coaching and mentoring engineers through context, guidance, collaboration, and example rather than authority or gatekeeping. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong ownership, initiative, and problem-solving skills, combined with a consistent drive to improve systems, teams, and processes. Comfortable working in a distributed, remote-first environment with a high degree of autonomy and trust. Experience with SEO, web performance, or large-scale rendering infrastructure is a plus, but curiosity, adaptability, and strong engineering fundamentals are valued more highly than specific industry experience. Benefits 100% remote work, offering flexibility to work from Europe and beyond within the applicable remote-work framework. High degree of autonomy and trust, with freedom to determine how best to solve technical challenges. Flexible working arrangements designed to support sustainable performance and individual needs. Minimal bureaucracy, unnecessary meetings, and red tape, allowing teams to maintain momentum. Flexible time off to support rest, recovery, and a healthy work-life balance. Opportunity to work with a small, friendly, collaborative engineering team. Access to a broader international network of SaaS professionals for knowledge sharing, learning, and exchanging ideas. Opportunity to have significant influence across engineering teams, architecture, tooling, and technical practices. Location-adjusted compensation aligned with local market medians for a remote-first environment, with the salary range communicated in writing before the first interview. Inclusive and diverse working environment where fresh perspectives and different backgrounds are valued. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
